label: Word Analysis
raw_text: Acquire and apply word analysis skills to deconstruct and construct words to make meaning.
child_texts: Identify frequently occurring root words (e.g., look) and inflectional endings used to form and comprehend new words (e.g., looks, looked, looking). (I)
Construct words using frequently occurring roots words and inflectional endings. (C)
competency_statement: Students acquire and apply word analysis skills to break down and build words to understand their meanings.
observable_behaviors: Identify root words and inflectional endings in spoken or written words.
Use root words and inflectional endings to form new words.
Recognize how adding endings changes word meanings or forms.
skill_clauses: Identify frequently occurring root words and inflectional endings used to form and comprehend new words.
Construct words using frequently occurring root words and inflectional endings.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Identify frequently occurring root words and inflectional endings in words.
student_actions.written_production: Construct words using frequently occurring root words and inflectional endings.
student_actions.procedural_application: Apply knowledge of root words and inflectional endings to understand and form new words.
